headline: Meta's new commercial terms let it use business accounts' data for AI
summary: Meta updated its commercial terms of service in a move legal experts call an AI power grab, potentially letting the company avoid millions in AI licensing fees. Business account holders are now consenting to AI scraping of their content, with no opt-out available.

claims.statement: Meta streamlined its commercial terms of service in a way legal experts warn amounts to an AI power grab, potentially avoiding millions in AI licensing fees.

sources.quote: Meta may use sweeping new commercial TOS to avoid millions in AI licensing fees
Meta “streamlined” its commercial TOS. Legal experts warn it’s an AI power grab.
